requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

adjunct_diet_and_activity.text:
LAB RESULT NOTE — 08/20/2025
Lipid panel drawn after a light breakfast — TG not interpretable. Repeat fasting (10–12 hours, water only). Order re-entered.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 32.0 — plan starting today:
 - Reduced-calorie meal plan of about 1600 kcal/day with food logging in a phone app.
 - Walking about 30 minutes 5 days a week.
 - Referred to a dietitian-led weight management program.
 Follow-up visits planned.
2. Eczema — stable.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 01/05/2026
Dietitian-led program intake. Food log: large dinners, snacking after dinner (ice cream, chips), sweetened coffee.
Plan: ~1600 kcal/day logged in phone app; portion guidance; one planned evening snack; unsweetened coffee.
Activity: walking ~30 min 5 days/week.
RD follow-up 6–8 weeks.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 03/01/2026
S: Follow-up. Continues the meal plan and walking started in December; logging most days. Good adherence most weeks. Some nausea on and off.
O: Wt 90.1 kg, BMI 31.9. BP 126/73.
A/P:
1. Obesity — continue program.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 05/27/2026
Food log reviewed: adherent most days, ~1600 kcal.
Adjustments: smaller dinner portions, protein at breakfast.
Reports keeping up with walking.
Continue program.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/12/2026
S: Follow-up. Continues the diet and exercise plan and dietitian follow-ups since December. Frustrated — weight 88.9 kg today vs 90.3 kg when the lifestyle plan began (-1.6%) despite reported adherence.
Medications: stopped Ozempic about 2 months ago because of nausea and cost; not currently taking it. Asks about Wegovy instead. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis.
O: Wt 88.9 kg, BMI 31.5. BP 123/71.
